mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive over the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.05% over the prior month signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical rate cuts correlate with SPX rallies
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.05% within one month signals preemptive monetary easing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) over the prior month indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1500.0 thousand units signals robust residential construction, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 620000 million dollars over the prior two months signals strong consumer spending, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 620000.
